Bluey's Happy Snaps releases on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch October 15, 2026: https://ninten.do/6006aW3LE

There’s so much to see, do, and snap in Bluey’s Happy Snaps!  

Join Bindi Irwin to zoom in on the exciting details in this brand-new Bluey adventure. Explore real locations from the show, play heaps of games, and snap wonderful wildlife around Bluey’s home!
